articles.summary: To help customers prepare their gas appliances for safe use during the cold weather months ahead, Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PGE) offers free in-home gas safety checks. During the gas safety checks, PGE also will re-light pilot lights for customers who have heaters or other appliances that have been turned off during warmer months. Free safety checks help ensure that gas appliances, including water heaters, furnaces and ovens, are operating safely and efficiently, reducing the risk of carbon monoxide (CO) poisoning within the home. Carbon monoxide is especially dangerous because it can't be seen, smelled or heard. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention , each year more than 400 Americans die from unintentional CO poisoning not linked to fires, more than 100,000 visit the emergency room, and more than 14,000 are hospitalized.
